subject: Next steps: rotating deep-dive slots and demo baton
messages:
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novacorp.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@novacorp.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed rotating deep-dive slots

Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Recap: NovaCorp is evaluating Redwood for a production inference path across internal apps (search ranking + chat assistants). Key asks: predictable latency, multi-tenant isolation, and cross-region routing for EU/US/APAC.
- Objective for next meeting: technical deep-dive (30–45m) with infra + ML infra leads to validate integration approach and capacity targets.

Scheduling ask: to make this simple across time zones and minimize back-and-forth, below are three rotating bands we can run for a short pilot (we rotate the on-call presenter between our US/EU/APAC engineers week-to-week):

1) Pacific-friendly morning band (US west morning, EU afternoon, APAC late evening) — 15:30–16:30 UTC (07:30 PT / 10:30 ET / 16:30 CET / 00:30 SGT)
2) Europe core band (EU mid-morning, US late night, APAC evening) — 09:30–10:15 UTC (01:30 PT / 04:30 ET / 10:30 CET / 17:30 SGT)
3) APAC-first band (APAC morning, EU evening, US late afternoon) — 00:00–00:45 UTC (16:00 PT prev day / 19:00 ET prev day / 01:00 CET / 08:00 SGT)

Can you confirm which band works best for your team this week? If none, please drop 2–3 concrete windows (in your local time) and we’ll map to our rotation.

I attached the short deck we referenced and a simple CSV grid that shows the suggested rotation plan (who presents each week). If it helps, here’s our public Calendly if you prefer to book directly: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/60min

Next steps after scheduling: we’ll send an agenda and list of required attendees (network/infra + ML infra + security).

Thanks — look forward to getting the deep-dive on the calendar.

— Markus Klein
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
(Attached: redwood-prod-deep-dive-deck.pdf; availability-rotation-grid.csv)

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novacorp.com>

Date: 2026-11-01T18:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed rotating deep-dive slots

Hi Markus — thanks for the clear recap. Priya and I confirmed with our infra lead (she's looped in here) and the team prefers either the Europe core band or the Pacific-friendly band for this week. 

Preferred windows (local times):
- Thurs 11/04 10:30–11:15 CET (works for most EU folks)
- Fri 11/05 07:30–08:30 PT (works for our west coast engineers)

Attendees we expect from NovaCorp: Priya (product), Rajesh Kumar (infra lead, rajesh.kumar@novacorp.com), and myself. Rajesh flagged he needs the network diagram + expected egress volumes ahead of the deep-dive. If you can include those in the agenda or attach, that'd be ideal.

I'll paste a Calendly link to our team's availability: https://calendly.com/novacorp/infra-30min — feel free to pick a slot and we'll confirm.

Thanks — Alex

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai

Alex / Priya / Markus — thanks, quick operational note from Redwood side:

I attached a one-page "rotation baton" that maps weeks 1–6 to our on-call presenters (US/EU/APAC). Our ask is that NovaCorp pick one of the bands for the first two sessions so we can validate sequencing and latency expectations. After week 2 we will rotate the presenter and capture token-level latency traces as part of the pilot.

We will include the network diagram + estimated egress numbers in the agenda doc (attached as a Google Drive link in the HubSpot deal). For immediate context: expect ~50–100 GB/day for a moderate chat assistant workload at 5 RPS and 512-token context. We'll confirm exact numbers after we see your traffic patterns.

Proposed primary slots this week (converted to your local times):
- Thurs 11/04 10:30–11:15 CET (09:30–10:15 UTC) — EU core band
- Fri 11/05 07:30–08:30 PT (14:30–15:30 UTC) — Pacific-friendly band

If Alex wants, I can go ahead and grab the Thurs EU slot on your Calendly; otherwise markus / I can send a formal invite once you confirm attendees.

Bench attachments: redwood-prod-deep-dive-deck.pdf; availability-rotation-grid.csv

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
